title: Bigger Summary Boxes
subtitle: The boxes at the top of the Spending tab and the Financial Summary get bigger numbers and easier-to-read lines underneath, and Fixed vs flexible says what it adds up.
intro: The code is already in your Sheet. The upgrade redraws the Spending tab and the Financial Summary; your Month, Compare with and months settings stay as they are.
**What does not change:** every number. Only the size of the boxes and the wording under Fixed vs flexible change.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before bigger boxes 2026-11-26`.
Reload the Sheet. Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.34.1`. If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload again.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.

steps.done: The boxes at the top have bigger numbers and larger lines underneath. Under **Fixed vs flexible** it now says "spent so far in November: fixed = bills and subscriptions, flexible = everyday spending". The numbers are the same as before.
The four cards (Coming In, Fixed Costs, Flexible Spending, Likely Left Over) are bigger, with the same numbers. If any line underneath is cut off, tell Claude which one.
